suggestions: replace intersect with union all and group by
use group by and having to enforce distinct channels
convert INTERSECT to UNION ALL with HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT)
pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
optimized_sql:
SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT ch2.c_last_name AS c_last_name,
           ch2.c_first_name AS c_first_name,
           ch2.d_date AS d_date
    FROM (
        SELECT c.c_last_name AS c_last_name,
               c.c_first_name AS c_first_name,
               ch.d_date AS d_date,
               ch.channel AS channel
        FROM (
            SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
                   dd.d_date AS d_date,
                   's' AS channel
            FROM store_sales AS ss
            JOIN date_dim AS dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
            WHERE dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
            GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk, dd.d_date
            UNION ALL
            SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
                   dd.d_date AS d_date,
                   'c' AS channel
            FROM catalog_sales AS cs
            JOIN date_dim AS dd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
            WHERE dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
            GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, dd.d_date
            UNION ALL
            SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
                   dd.d_date AS d_date,
                   'w' AS channel
            FROM web_sales AS ws
            JOIN date_dim AS dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
            WHERE dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
            GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, dd.d_date
        ) AS ch
        JOIN customer AS c ON c.c_customer_sk = ch.customer_sk
    ) AS ch2
    GROUP BY ch2.c_last_name, ch2.c_first_name, ch2.d_date
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch2.channel) = 3
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
